name: Stellar Capital Services Limited
about: Stellar Capital Services Limited, a non-banking financial company, engages in lending activities in India. The company offers financial services, such as inter corporate deposits, financial consultancy, retail IPO funding, loans against property, management consultancy, and personal and unsecured loans. It is also involved in investing/trading in securities. Stellar Capital Services Limited was incorporated in 1994 and is based in Gurugram, India.
